PassBy is a simple password notebook. Keep titles, accounts, passwords and notes together, organize them in folders, and generate strong passwords to copy into other apps.

No account, and nothing goes through our servers. The notebook is kept by your phone and follows the phone\'s own backup and transfer to a new phone. The app stays offline by default; it connects to the network only when you turn on one feature, AI grouping.

On. Connects to the network when used
Lets an AI model you choose sort your passwords into folders by their titles, and suggest tidier titles. It is the only feature of PassBy that connects to the network, and it is off by default.
The AI gets titles and folder names only.
The account, password and notes fields are never sent. Before each send, you can see everything that will go out.
When on, PassBy connects only when you tap Send. Turning it off deletes the API key and these settings.
The endpoint has to start with https://.
The provider\'s address has changed. Saving deletes the API key you entered, and you will need to enter one again.

The endpoint filled in by default is DeepSeek\'s; you can change it to any provider with a compatible chat/completions endpoint. The service is provided by that provider under its own terms and privacy policy; with a provider outside mainland China, your titles are sent abroad.

The API key is one you get from the provider yourself; its charges are between you and the provider. It is stored encrypted on this phone, left out of system backups and export files, and not shown again once saved.
The next page shows what will be sent. Nothing is sent yet.
When on, PassBy connects to the network once each time you tap Send, and at no other time.
Only your entries\' titles and your folder names are sent. Accounts, passwords and notes are never sent.

What you send goes from this phone straight to the provider you entered, not through us. The service is provided by that provider under its own terms and privacy policy; with a provider outside mainland China, the content is sent abroad. An account name or a person\'s name written into a title is sent along with it.
The API key is stored encrypted on this phone only.
This deletes the API key and provider settings saved on this phone. Your notebook is not affected. Once off, PassBy no longer connects to the network.

An API key can hold only letters, digits and symbols, with no spaces, line breaks or other characters. Check that nothing else was copied with it.
With another device on the same Wi-Fi
On the same Wi-Fi, sync this phone\'s notebook with another phone, or with the web page on a computer. What is sent is encrypted and goes only between the two devices, never through our servers.
Enter this address and code on the other device. It can connect only while this page is open, and the code is new every time.
Send the address to a computer
